types.name: XmlProcessor
types.reason: XFDF XML input; feasible with string literal or file fixture

next_candidate.rationale: XFDF XML is a text-based format. Fixture can be a string literal or a small XML file created programmatically. No external cert/key deps. Primary LowCode API is XmlProcessor.Process(options) with FileDataSource input/output.
next_candidate.fixture_strategy: Programmatic XFDF XML string written to file: var xml = "<?xml version='1.0'?><xfdf><f href='input.pdf'/><fields/></xfdf>"; File.WriteAllText("input.xfdf", xml);
next_candidate.expected_code_pattern: var opts = new XmlProcessorOptions(); opts.AddInput(new FileDataSource("input.pdf")); opts.AddInput(new FileDataSource("input.xfdf")); opts.AddOutput(new FileDataSource("output.pdf")); new XmlProcessor().Process(opts);

acroform_strategy.rationale: 5 AcroForm types (FormEditor/FormExporter/FormFlattener/FormImporter/SelectField) all require a PDF with interactive form fields (AcroForm fields). Programmatic creation possible via Aspose.Pdf.Forms namespace.
acroform_strategy.fixture_approach: Create AcroForm PDF programmatically: new Document(); page.Paragraphs.Add(new TextBoxField(page, new Rectangle(100,100,200,130)) { PartialName="field1", Value="test" }); doc.Save("acroform.pdf");
acroform_strategy.prerequisite: Design and validate AcroForm fixture in standalone harness before generation
